title: Starter Call visual kit for Hosted API — model picker & request composer screenshots
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Produce a compact, production-ready visual kit for the Hosted API onboarding flow focused on the first successful call (model selection, request composer, and code snippets). Deliver high-fidelity desktop and mobile screenshots, retina and non-retina exports, dark-mode variants, and localized English/French/German labels for the release doc and Quickstart page. Assets should be optimized for docs hero (1200x630), inline docs tiles (800x450), and console carousel (360x200).

Scope: model picker (grid + compact list), request composer (preset templates + headers + example request body), streaming response UI, error/validation states (no model, rate limit, invalid key), and language-specific code tiles (curl, Python requests, Node fetch). Include copy-to-clipboard affordances and inline token-cost hint.

Design notes: use compact cards with token-cost microcopy, highlight recommended model badge, show automatic schema/structured-output examples in the composer, and surface "Try in Console" CTA in each screenshot. Ensure copy buttons, language tabs, and streaming spinner are visible in thumbnails. Accessibility: WCAG AA contrast for text, keyboard focus ring shown on composer controls.

Artifacts and links: Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/Redwood/Onboard-2026-Starter-Call (page: Starter Call Kit); PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ONBOARD/Starter+Call+Kit; Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1StarterCallAssets; GitHub design PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821.

Notes on uniqueness: This kit is intentionally compact and example-first, emphasizing the "first successful call" narrative rather than a deep onboarding tour. Screenshots should read as a single linear journey: select model -> compose request -> view streaming output -> copy code -> run. Avoid reusing older artboard names; use the new naming convention in attachments.
